_doc: Ask an AI settings for topic notes. Edit this file to change the wording, add a mode, or switch assistants — no code changes needed. Placeholders are filled from the open topic note only (never the student's name, school or grades): {subject} (e.g. Biology), {level} (HL or SL), {topic} (code, title and theme), {understandings} (key-idea cues with statement codes), {keyterms} (term: short definition), {wrong_questions} (stems of unresolved misses on this topic's linked quiz items; our own question text only, no markschemes). subjectNames (optional) maps a subject id to a proper course name for {subject}; the level still comes from a -hl/-sl suffix or hlOnly. Mode templates may use only these placeholders. default_ai must match an assistants[].id. After editing, run ./dev.sh test (or node --test tests/js/ai-prompt.test.js).
preamble: You are an experienced IB {subject} {level} teacher. The student is in DP1 (first year of the Diploma Programme) and will sit first exams in May 2028. Stay on the current IB {subject} {level} syllabus for {topic}. If you are unsure, say so. Do not present your questions or marking notes as real IB exam questions, markschemes or exam predictions. Do not ask for or use any personal information about the student.

modes.label: Explain, then check my understanding
Quiz me one question at a time
Data-response in an unfamiliar scenario
Help with my wrong answers
